description: Create a new permission target in JFrog Artifactory to allow anonymous (unauthenticated) users to read from the 'example-repo-local' repository. Settings: Permission Target Name: 'public-read', Repositories: include 'example-repo-local', Users: grant 'anonymous' the 'Read' permission. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 using username 'admin' and password 'password'. Navigate to Administration > Security > Permissions, click '+ New Permission', enter the name 'public-read', add the 'example-repo-local' repository in the Resources section, then in the Users/Groups section add 'anonymous' with Read permission, and save. The permission target must be created.
